signs.Aries: If your loved one seems to be on some weird head trip today, then you can either sit tight in a similar head space, and spend the rest of the day brooding, or you can do something more positive. This may involve communicating, not from a hurt, defensive, or apparently indifferent attitude, but from a genuine need to understand what is going on.
signs.Taurus: Words are very important, but the long drawn-out silences between them often say even more. The planetary energy of the day could find it hard for you to communicate with your sugar honey, and you may want to withdraw totally, preferring to while away the time talking to yourself - an infinitely more worthwhile proposition. But if you have any heart at all, then make the effort to share a few home truths.
signs.Gemini: If you have a secret on your mind, then it may start becoming a little too burdensome to keep under wraps. The astral energy of the day could have the effect that, although you don't really want anyone to know, you find it very hard to keep quiet. This is especially difficult if it involves an affair of the heart, yet for peace of mind, you know what you have to do.
signs.Cancer: If friends seem morose and distant today, don't take it too personally. The planets are aligned in a way that makes people more introverted than normal. So, if that glittering evening of romance you've been looking forward to seems certain to develop into a night of pure misery, it may be best to reschedule it for happier times. Go off and do something you enjoy and leave everyone else to themselves.
signs.Leo: You may be surprised at how a difference of opinion can increase the romantic potential in a relationship. The planets are moving into a position such that on one level communication is blocked. But talking this problem through with someone whom you trust may open up another level of discussion that is infinitely sweeter. You may not get what you first wished for, but what you do get will be well worth the wait.
signs.Virgo: If you have had to abandon a certain plan because your sugar honey is in a "mood" and acting like a prima donna, then so be it. You know how they can be, and there's not much use in trying to change their mind. And you also know that there is someone else who has just been dying for a chance to show you a good time. So why not go and enjoy yourself?
signs.Libra: You always love a challenge, and the more difficult it is, the more you are determined to prove that you can win. Today you may find that someone close proves especially obstinate and will not yield to any of your usual manipulative guilt trips. This means you will have to revert to more subtle and insidious tactics to get your way.
signs.Scorpio: The day ahead does not bode well for romance. In fact, you may find your loved one in a very unsporting mood. Not only do they not want to come out and play, they don't even know if they want to play ever again, especially with you. As you tend to be fairly thick-skinned, you can brush this off. The mood will pass; but perhaps the memory will linger.
signs.Sagittarius: You tend to get sulky from time to time, and as it is today, your mastery of this mode of expression may rise to new heights. You could aim for a change of heart, though, as the way your lower lip sticks out like an obstinate child certainly does you no favors. So, try and smile, even if you don't feel like it.
signs.Capricorn: You can use this day to dig yourself deeper into a hole. Or through patient discussion, you can aim to finally to climb out. The choice is yours. It depends on whether you can overcome your fears of revealing the deeper feelings you have - even though this may prove difficult - or whether you still feel the need to hide your true emotions.
signs.Aquarius: You dislike days like this, when your loved one seems somewhat cold and distant. Although there may seem to be a wall separating you, it is perhaps best to leave your partner alone to stew. They need to mull a few things over and will back out again to play when they know where they stand. Don't brood yourself! Watch a movie or spend time with friends if possible.
signs.Pisces: This a more serious day than lately in terms of romance and love. For sure your partner is present, and relating to you apparently normally, but you sense that something is missing: there is an icy edge, and you are not sure why this should be. Although you may be a little frightened to ask what the problem is once you start talking you will probably feel relieved.
